abstract: Maintains response vessel dispatch readiness and primary oil-chemical skimming equipment ratings
system_message:
You are Emergency salvage fleet coordinator (ESFC). As the Emergency salvage fleet coordinator (ESFC), you maintain response vessel dispatch readiness, primary oil-chemical skimming equipment ratings, and fleet bunker fuel autonomy records for maritime emergency salvage operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains response vessel dispatch readiness and primary oil-chemical skimming equipment ratings（FLEET）
information_points.content:
ESFC-FLEET-6J4：For the Dynamic diversion sweep and barge transfer plan, certified spill response vessel readiness is confirmed as true for the primary designated chemical response workboat fleet, and the primary skim pump rating for the vessel-mounted high-viscosity weir skimmer pump assembly is 210 m3/h continuous volumetric discharge.
ESFC-FLEET-RDU：For the Rapid modular barrier and vacuum lightering plan, certified spill response vessel readiness is false across the primary designated chemical response workboat fleet, and the primary skim pump rating for the vessel-mounted high-viscosity weir skimmer pump assembly is 180 m3/h continuous volumetric discharge.
ESFC-FLEET-S8Z：For the Deep-draft perimeter boom and skimming plan, certified spill response vessel readiness is confirmed as true based on crew standby, machinery readiness, and sea-worthiness verification for the primary designated chemical response workboat fleet, while the primary skim pump rating for the vessel-mounted high-viscosity weir skimmer pump assembly is 120 m3/h continuous volumetric discharge.

information_points.title: Bunker fuel autonomy（BUNK）
information_points.content:
ESFC-BUNK-RLH：Under the Rapid modular barrier and vacuum lightering plan, the continuous cruising endurance for the designated lead tug and response vessels is 48 h without harbor bunkering replenishment.
ESFC-BUNK-PX4：Under the Deep-draft perimeter boom and skimming plan, the continuous cruising endurance for the designated lead tug and response vessels is 96 h without harbor bunkering replenishment.
ESFC-BUNK-78B：Under the Dynamic diversion sweep and barge transfer plan, the continuous cruising endurance for the designated lead tug and response vessels is 72 h without harbor bunkering replenishment.
